insight.title: How the invisible dance shapes your morning
insight.subtitle: Beneath the surface of the stillest room, everything is in motion

sections.text: You are standing in a room that is never still. Even when the air feels silent and your coffee looks motionless, a frantic energy hums beneath. Every object holds a sea of vibrating particles, bumping together in an endless rush. We live inside a world that is constantly, quietly shivering.

This secret movement is what we call heat. When you hold a warm mug, you feel a literal transfer of motion. Fast-moving molecules in the clay strike the slower ones in your palms, sharing momentum like tiny billiard balls. It is an invisible negotiation between every object you touch.

This hidden system ensures that nothing remains isolated. Every breath you take and every step you make adjusts the temperature of the universe. We are not just observers, but participants in a grand balance. Your smallest gesture ripples outward, changing the rhythm of the molecules around you forever.
Warmth is the feeling of the universe sharing its energy with you.

news.title: Gas Prices Could Hit $5 a Gallon This Month If Iran War Drags on: JPMorgan
news.description: The average gas price jumped above $4 per gallon for the first time since 2022 amid the war in Iran. JPMorgan warns that $5 is in sight for US drivers.
news.why: Your daily commute and grocery deliveries could become significantly more expensive.

news.title: Microsoft Signals AI Caution as Copilot Terms Highlight Reliability Limits
news.description: Microsoft has reinforced the limitations of AI systems through updated scrutiny of its Copilot terms of use, as the company continues expanding enterprise
news.why: You should manually verify AI-generated work to prevent errors at your job.

news.title: Samsung to shut down Samsung Messages in July, urging users to switch to Google Messages
news.description: Samsung is saying goodbye its namesake texting app. According to an end of service announcement published on the tech giant’s U.S. support website, Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July.
news.why: You will need to move your text history to a different app.

news.title: Federal Agency Unveils Three Potential Osteoarthritis Treatments
news.description: With funding from ARPA-H, three teams of researchers have regrown bone and cartilage, even entire knees, in animal studies. Human trials are not far off.
news.why: You may eventually heal joint pain by regrowing your own bone tissue.
